```{r setup, message=F, warning=F, echo=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = F, warning = F, echo = F)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))
source("helper_functions/anchored_dif.R")

load("data/nda_private/cached_data.Rds")   # from 01_prep_data.Rmd
items <- read_csv("in_files/wordbank_2pl_items.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
norms <- read_csv("in_files/wordbank_2pl_ability_norms.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
load_one <- function(f) { e <- new.env(); load(f, envir = e); base::get(ls(e)[1], envir = e) }
```

## Approach

`04_DIF_analysis.Rmd` fits a separate Rasch model to each group and links the two
scales by assuming the average item has no DIF (mean–mean linking). Here the TD side
is instead a **fixed, external item bank**: the Wordbank English 2PL from
`adaptive-cdi`, calibrated on 7,633 children aged 12–36 months (WS and WG production
on a common 680-item scale; `in_files/wordbank_2pl_items.csv`).

With item parameters fixed:

1. The ASD sample's ability distribution is estimated on the Wordbank scale (EM over a
   quadrature grid, anchor items only).
2. For each item, a shift *δ* is estimated so that
   P(produce | θ) = logistic(*a*θ + *d* + *δ*), averaging over each child's posterior
   over θ. An item's own response is left out of the posterior it is judged against.
   **δ < 0 = harder for ASD children than for Wordbank children of the same ability.**
   A slope change (non-uniform DIF) is also tested.
3. Items with BH-adjusted *p* < .05 and |*δ*| > 0.5 logits are dropped from the
   anchor set and the sample is re-scored, until the anchor set stops changing.
4. Items with BH-adjusted *p* < .05 and |*δ*| > 1 logit (an odds ratio of 2.7 at the
   same ability) are **flagged** as large DIF; 0.5–1 logit is reported as moderate.
   With fixed item parameters, standard errors are small (≈0.2 logits), so most
   items with even modest shifts are significant: the effect-size cut-off does the work.

Unlike mean–mean linking, this does not force the average DIF to zero: the scale is
set by the Wordbank calibration and the DIF-free anchors. A simulation from the item
bank (385 children, 30 items with planted DIF of ±1–1.5 logits, `helper_functions/anchored_dif.R`)
recovered 29/30 DIF items with 2 false positives and r = .98 between true and
estimated *δ*.

```{r run}
asd_keep <- function(d, drop_unconfirmed = FALSE) {
  d <- d %>% filter(one_per_child)
  if (!params$include_flagged) d <- d %>% filter(item_profile_ok)
  if (drop_unconfirmed) d <- d %>% filter(!asd_dx_unconfirmed)
  d
}

runs <- expand_grid(form = c("WS", "WG"), drop_unconfirmed = c(FALSE, TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(version = ifelse(drop_unconfirmed, "dx_confirmed", "main"))

results <- pmap(runs, function(form, drop_unconfirmed, version) {
  d <- if (form == "WS") d_asd_ws else d_asd_wg
  X <- response_matrix(asd_keep(d, drop_unconfirmed), items)
  anchored_dif(X, items)
})
names(results) <- paste(runs$form, runs$version, sep = "_")

suffix <- if (params$include_flagged) "_withflagged" else ""
anchored <- list(runs = runs, results = results)
save(anchored, file = sprintf("data/nda_private/anchored_dif%s.Rds", suffix))

res_items <- map2_dfr(results, names(results), ~ .x$items %>%
  mutate(run = .y) %>% separate(run, c("form", "version"), sep = "_", extra = "merge")) %>%
  left_join(items %>% select(definition, a, d_wb = d, b), by = "definition") %>%
  left_join(d_td_ws %>% distinct(definition, category), by = "definition") %>%
  mutate(category = str_replace_all(category, "_", " "))

summ <- map2_dfr(results, names(results), ~ tibble(
  run = .y, children = nrow(.x$theta), mu = .x$mu, sigma = .x$sigma,
  iterations = .x$iterations, anchors = sum(.x$items$anchor),
  moderate = sum(.x$items$size == "moderate"),
  flagged = sum(.x$items$flagged),
  harder = sum(.x$items$flagged & .x$items$delta < 0),
  easier = sum(.x$items$flagged & .x$items$delta > 0),
  nonuniform = sum(p.adjust(.x$items$p_nonuniform, "BH") < .05 & .x$items$informative)))
```

```{r summary-table}
summ %>% mutate(across(c(mu, sigma), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Run", "Children", "Ability mean", "Ability SD", "Iterations",
                      "Anchors", "Moderate DIF", "Large DIF (flagged)", "Harder for ASD", "Easier for ASD",
                      "Non-uniform (BH < .05)"),
        caption = "Ability is on the Wordbank scale (calibration sample: mean 0, SD 1). 'dx_confirmed' drops collections without a confirmed ASD diagnosis.")
```

## Check: Wordbank item bank vs our TD Rasch fit

The TD group in `04` is a Wordbank subsample, so this mainly checks that the item
orderings agree across the two calibrations (Rasch on WS 16–30 months vs 2PL on WS+WG
12–36 months).

```{r bank-check, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
rasch <- map_dfr(c("WS", "WG"), ~ load_one(sprintf("data/nda_private/dif_items_%s.Rds", .x)) %>%
                   transmute(definition, d_TD = d_g1, d_diff_c, extreme) %>% mutate(form = .x)) %>%
  mutate(definition = ifelse(form == "WG" & definition %in% c("in", "inside"), "inside/in", definition)) %>%
  distinct(form, definition, .keep_all = TRUE)
chk <- rasch %>% filter(form == "WS") %>% inner_join(items, by = "definition")
ggplot(chk, aes(-b, d_TD)) + geom_point(alpha = .4) +
  labs(x = "Wordbank 2PL easiness (−b)", y = "TD Rasch easiness (d), 04",
       subtitle = sprintf("WS items: r = %.3f", cor(-chk$b, chk$d_TD)))
```

## Ability on the Wordbank scale

```{r ability, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
theta <- map2_dfr(results[c("WS_main", "WG_main")], c("WS", "WG"), ~ .x$theta %>% mutate(form = .y)) %>%
  left_join(admins %>% select(form, row, age, collection_id, asd_dx_unconfirmed), by = c("form", "row"))
nb <- norms %>% filter(n >= 50)
ggplot(theta, aes(age, theta)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = nb, aes(x = age, ymin = q10, ymax = q90), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey85") +
  geom_ribbon(data = nb, aes(x = age, ymin = q25, ymax = q75), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey70") +
  geom_line(data = nb, aes(x = age, y = q50), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = asd_dx_unconfirmed), width = .3, alpha = .5, size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~form) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#2471a3", `TRUE` = "#e67e22"),
                      labels = c("dx confirmed collections", "dx unconfirmed (2024)"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "Ability (Wordbank 2PL scale)",
       caption = "Grey bands: Wordbank 10–90th and 25–75th percentiles; line: median") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r language-age}
theta <- theta %>% mutate(lang_age = language_age(theta, norms), delay = age - lang_age)
theta %>% group_by(form, dx_unconfirmed = asd_dx_unconfirmed) %>%
  summarise(children = n(), median_age = median(age),
            below_10th = mean(theta < approx(nb$age, nb$q10, xout = age, rule = 2)$y),
            median_delay = median(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            delay_n = sum(!is.na(delay)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(below_10th = scales::percent(below_10th, 1), median_delay = round(median_delay, 1)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Form", "Dx unconfirmed", "Children", "Median age", "Below Wordbank 10th %ile",
                      "Median delay (mo)", "Children with a language age"),
        caption = "Below 10th %ile: ability below the Wordbank 10th percentile for the child's age (ages outside 12–30 months compared with the nearest norm month). Language age: age at which the Wordbank median reaches the child's ability, defined only within the 12–30-month norm range.")
```

## DIF results

```{r dif-plot-fn}
dif_plot <- function(f) {
  d <- res_items %>% filter(form == f, version == "main", informative)
  ggplot(d, aes(b, delta)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", alpha = .4) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = case_when(!flagged ~ "not flagged",
                                      delta < 0 ~ "harder for ASD",
                                      TRUE ~ "easier for ASD")), alpha = .7) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = filter(d, flagged), aes(label = definition),
                             size = 2.8, max.overlaps = 40) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("harder for ASD" = "#c0392b", "easier for ASD" = "#2471a3",
                                   "not flagged" = "grey75"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "Wordbank difficulty (b)", y = "DIF δ (logits)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
flag_table <- function(f) {
  res_items %>% filter(form == f) %>%
    select(definition, category, version, delta, se, dprob, flagged) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = c(delta, se, dprob, flagged)) %>%
    filter(flagged_main | flagged_dx_confirmed) %>%
    arrange(delta_main) %>%
    transmute(Item = definition, Section = category,
              `δ (SE)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", delta_main, se_main),
              `Δ P(produce)` = scales::percent(dprob_main, 1),
              `δ without 2024` = round(delta_dx_confirmed, 2),
              Flagged = case_when(flagged_main & flagged_dx_confirmed ~ "both",
                                  flagged_main ~ "main only", TRUE ~ "without 2024 only"))
}
```

### By CDI section

```{r sections, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
res_items %>% filter(version == "main", informative, !is.na(category)) %>%
  group_by(form, category) %>%
  summarise(mean_delta = mean(delta), se = sd(delta) / sqrt(n()), flagged = sum(flagged), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(category, mean_delta), mean_delta, fill = mean_delta < 0)) +
  geom_col() + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_delta - se, ymax = mean_delta + se), width = .2) +
  facet_wrap(~form) + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c0392b", `FALSE` = "#2471a3"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean δ (± SE)")
```

## Comparison with the Rasch DIF in 04

```{r compare, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
cmp <- res_items %>% filter(version == "main", informative) %>%
  inner_join(rasch, by = c("form", "definition"))
cmp_stats <- cmp %>% group_by(form) %>%
  summarise(r = cor(delta, d_diff_c), both = sum(flagged & extreme),
            anchored_only = sum(flagged & !extreme), rasch_only = sum(!flagged & extreme))
ggplot(cmp, aes(d_diff_c, delta)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") + geom_point(alpha = .4) +
  facet_wrap(~form) +
  labs(x = "Rasch centered DIF (04)", y = "Anchored DIF δ (this notebook)")
kable(cmp_stats, digits = 2, col.names = c("Form", "r", "Flagged in both", "Anchored only", "Rasch only"))
```

## Notes

- The Wordbank calibration covers 12–36 months, while the ASD WS sample spans 12–48
  months. Ability is still defined for older children, but item parameters were not
  estimated on children that old, and the language-age conversion stops at 30 months.
- Standard errors treat item parameters as known and ignore clustering by collection.
  A bootstrap over children (or collections) would widen them.
- The ASD group is defined by collection, not by a child-level diagnosis. Collections
  include siblings and possibly non-autistic controls; child-level labels from NDA
  (`ndar_subject01` phenotype, ADOS/ADI-R) are the next step.
